summary.text: Daniel Walls is the Constitution Party candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 95, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked in factories and trucking terminals and that his core issues are opposing government-backed data centers and eliminating the state fuel tax.
